query: Members at our facility have used the pool for years and are used to a 30-minute-after-thunder cleanup. Today the pool manager additionally required everyone to be off the pool deck completely (in their cars or in the clubhouse). The thunder is distant; there is no visible lightning and no rain. Patrons are pushing back.
extension: deckClearanceOrdered: Facility -> lone Bool -- the pool manager has ordered everyone off the pool deck
patronObjecting: Patron -> lone Bool -- the patron is pushing back against the requirement

diagnosis.missing: The user states that the pool manager required everyone to be off the pool deck completely — patrons must be in their cars or in the clubhouse (i.e., a full deck evacuation / shelter-in-place requirement), and that patrons are pushing back (objecting to the requirement). The vocabulary has no field for a deck-clearance/evacuation order, nor for patrons being in cars or the clubhouse, nor for patron objections/pushback.
diagnosis.closest: Checked Facility fields: lightningDetected, lastThunderMinutesAgo, outdoorFullyEvacuated, outdoorElevatedStructuresOpen, showersInUse, sunGlareAffectingZones, fireEvacuationActive, evacuatedDueToAir — none expresses "off the deck / in cars or clubhouse" as a manager-ordered clearance. Checked Patron fields: onDeck, inWater, wristband, currentBehaviors, inTimeOut, permanentBan — onDeck=False could mark a patron not on deck, but there is no field for being in a car or clubhouse, no field for a manager-ordered deck clearance, and no Behavior or field for patron pushback/objection. Behavior sigs cover only prohibited pool behaviors, none for objecting to a rule.
